name: lijka depresiji
source:
deep underground, surrounded by stone walls, is my dwelling, the bottom of an old dry well. no one would think of coming here, would they? maybe it's a little tight and I don't have new things, but it's all mine, it's me. there is no place for me on the surface. 

[Translated from [url=https://awinya.itch.io/cone-of-depression]itch.io[/url]]
